_meta.note: GPT-6 Astra follow-up from four links. (1) OpenRouter: new model id openai/gpt-6-astra-pro (same weights, reasoning.mode=pro; OpenAI reasoning guide confirms pro mode bills at standard rates), context 1,050,000 / max output 128,000, endpoint prices match OpenAI's page; per-provider latency/throughput/uptime NOT ingested (volatile, no id). New AA variant openai/gpt-6-astra-non-reasoning. Opus 5 / Muse Spark 1.3 effort tiers skipped (no tier ids; best-per-base). (3) OpenAI pricing page: Standard short-context prices for the 4 flagships (+cache-write, long-context), cyber, realtime 2.1 (+mini, new ids), gpt-image-2, sora-2/-pro 1080p, six transcription models; o4-mini fine-tuning and 'chat-latest' alias skipped. (4) myclaw.ai review: secondary source restating OpenAI's docs (prices, 272K line, cutoff, effort levels, Critical-cyber designation) — zero new triples, used only as a cross-check.
